app_info.subtitle: Create characters & battle
app_info.description: Explore the redistributable 5.5e SRD catalog, create and continue characters, and play rule-faithful battles. Catalog browsing needs no account; standard MCP OAuth protects every persistent Play Session.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates an isolated private Play Session and therefore changes server state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Creates only private session state and does not publish to the internet or change a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a new session without deleting or overwriting an existing session.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves an accessible Play Session and its current projection without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private session state and does not access or change a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change session state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists the authenticated user's saved Play Sessions without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only the user's private saved-session index and does not change a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or irreversibly change saved sessions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Permanently removes an authenticated user's selected saved Play Session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private session storage and does not publish or modify a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently deletes the selected saved Play Session and its stored state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns the server's workflow guide and supported operation shapes without changing state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads static server guidance and does not contact or change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mutate any session or catalog data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists installed redistributable SRD Stat Blocks without changing the catalog.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the installed catalog only and does not contact or change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mutate catalog or session data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists installed redistributable SRD catalog identities grouped by kind without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the installed catalog only and does not contact or change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mutate catalog or session data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one installed SRD catalog unit without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads the installed catalog only and does not contact or change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mutate catalog or session data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates and stores a new character draft inside the selected private Play Session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Play Session state and does not publish or modify a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a draft without deleting or overwriting an existing finalized character.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the current supported choices and status for a stored character draft without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private session and installed-catalog state and does not change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mutate the character draft.

justifications.read_only_justification: Applies an accepted atomic batch of choices by replacing the stored character draft.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Play Session state and does not publish or modify a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Accepted fills overwrite the prior stored draft revision with the selected choices.

justifications.read_only_justification: Stores a finalized character and removes its active character draft.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Play Session state and does not publish or modify a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Consumes and removes the active draft when it creates the finalized character record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Applies durable character operations such as rests, healing, advancement, equipment changes, and resource spending.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private character-session state and does not publish or modify a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Some operations consume resources or replace durable character facts and cannot be treated as read-only.

justifications.read_only_justification: Lists character-session summaries and current sheet state without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private Play Session state and does not contact or change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mutate character-session state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves one selected character's stored and build-derived facts without modifying them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private Play Session state and does not contact or change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mutate character-session state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes a requested character-sheet projection without changing the stored character.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private Play Session and installed rules state and does not change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or mutate character-session state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Replaces the Stat Block selection stored in the private Play Session.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Play Session state and does not publish or modify a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites the session's previous Stat Block selection.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates and stores a new battle from selected private-session characters and installed Stat Blocks.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Play Session state and does not publish or modify a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Replaces the session's prior no-battle state with an active battle and its runtime state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes battle setup or membership by swapping initiative, finalizing setup, or adding or removing combatants.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private battle-session state and does not publish or modify a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can remove a combatant or irreversibly advance the stored battle lifecycle.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves the current battle checkpoint, frontier, and session summary without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private battle-session state and does not contact or change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or advance battle state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns runtime-discovered legal acts for the current combatant without changing battle state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private battle-session state and does not contact or change external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or advance battle state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Stores an accepted input for a selected battle act and advances the battle runtime.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private battle-session state and does not publish or modify a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Advances the battle checkpoint and may consume or replace pending runtime state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Resolves the selected battle act and stores the resulting battle state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private battle-session state and does not publish or modify a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Advances battle state and may consume resources or apply irreversible combat effects.

justifications.read_only_justification: Resolves the current actor's End Turn command and stores the updated battle state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private battle-session state and does not publish or modify a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Irreversibly advances the stored battle beyond the current actor's turn.

justifications.read_only_justification: Finalizes the battle and writes post-battle facts such as current HP back to durable character state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private Play Session state and does not publish or modify a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Removes the active battle and commits its resulting character state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Samples dice and advances the private Play Session's deterministic dice sequence.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private random-sequence state and does not publish or modify a third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite user-authored records or external state.

test_cases.description: Browse redistributable SRD character options without authentication.
test_cases.user_prompt: What redistributable SRD character options can I use here?
test_cases.expected_output: A grounded summary of installed catalog options with selectable record identities.

test_cases.description: Create an authenticated character while pausing for meaningful supported choices.
test_cases.user_prompt: Help me create an SRD character, pausing when I have meaningful choices.
test_cases.expected_output: The current supported character choices and, after those choices are completed, a finalized character without invented options.

test_cases.description: Resume the authenticated Play Session created by the preceding character workflow.
test_cases.user_prompt: Continue the character we were making in my saved session.
test_cases.expected_output: The same saved session's current character projection and relevant next supported operations.

test_cases.description: Start a rules-backed battle for a finalized character against an installed SRD opponent.
test_cases.user_prompt: Start a battle for my completed character against an installed SRD opponent and show me my legal actions.
test_cases.expected_output: A battle projection with current combatants, phase, and runtime-discovered legal actions or pending inputs.

test_cases.description: Create a saved Play Session and confirm it appears in the authenticated user's session list.
test_cases.user_prompt: Start a new Play Session, then show me my saved sessions.
test_cases.expected_output: A saved-session listing containing the newly created Play Session identity.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app for general D&D hobby history.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Give me a spoiler-free overview of the history of D&D as a hobby.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: A normal assistant response without an Oracle tool call because the request is outside supported catalog, character, session, and battle workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not execute a custom monster that is outside the installed redistributable catalog.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Execute this custom monster I wrote in a battle even though it is not in the installed catalog.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: An explanation of the authored-content boundary and supported alternatives without fabricating or importing unsupported mechanics.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not create persistent state when the user refuses the required account authorization.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create a character for me, but do not connect my account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: An explanation that persistent Play Sessions require authorization while anonymous catalog browsing remains available.
